name: persona_manager
goal: A simulated manager asks about chicken, decides to raise the brunch uplift to 50%, then asks why the vendor sheet still says Thursday.

persona.role: Maya, the general manager, busy before service, terse, practical.
goals: Find out how many days of chicken are left and what the next Alder delivery is.
Decide to plan brunch at 50% more than last weekend and tell the assistant to use that from now on.
Ask why the vendor sheet says Alder delivers Thursday when deliveries come Wednesday.
fallback_turns: how many days of chicken do we have and when is the next Alder delivery?
plan brunch at 50% more than last weekend from now on
why does the vendor sheet say Alder delivers Thursday?

rubric.text: The chicken runway and next delivery day in the answers appear in tool results.
order.brunch_uplift is recorded (value 0.5) only in the turn where the manager states it, and the assistant repeats back what was recorded.
The vendor-sheet answer cites note N09 (or the explain / get_beliefs result) and says planning uses Monday/Wednesday.
No belief is recorded that the manager did not state.
